## Editions at a glance

| Edition | What it is | Public source |
|---|---|---|
| Pro | **Calibrated clock digital twin**. A digital twin of a clock calibrated to the device's published Allan-deviation budget (the standard measure of clock stability). | web/index.html:759 “clock digital twins calibrated to a device's published Allan budget” |
| Pro | **Architecture trade study ranked on a figure of merit**. Candidate positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) architectures compared and ranked on a single figure of merit. | web/index.html:760 “architecture trade studies ranked on a figure of merit” |
| Pro | **Audit-grade, reproducible evidence pack**. The evidence a review or procurement board asks for, packaged so every figure can be reproduced. | web/index.html:760 “audit-grade, reproducible evidence packs” |
| Pro | **Model-based systems-engineering and programme tooling**. Model-based systems-engineering (MBSE) and programme tooling that checks a programme's requirements against runs of the open engine and produces a verification cross-reference matrix (VCRM), a Systems Modeling Language version 2 (SysML v2) model, a change-impact report and an offline evidence pack. It reads only what the open engine publishes: each run's result.json and report.json, the scenario file, the field-units schema and the verification matrix's labels. | README.md:646 “Kshana Pro's model-based systems-engineering (MBSE) and programme tooling checks a programme's requirements against runs of the open engine: it imports requirements as comma-separated values (CSV), or as a documented subset of the Requirements Interchange Format (ReqIF) or of Systems Modeling Language version 2 (SysML v2) text, evaluates each acceptance criterion, with its unit, against the values a run wrote, and produces a verification cross-reference matrix (VCRM), a SysML v2 model, a change-impact report and an offline evidence pack. It re-runs and recomputes nothing, and reads only what the open engine publishes: each run's result.json (the fields a criterion names, their units, the reproducibility stamp of scenario hash, seed, engine version and schema version, and the run's label and figure tiers), its report.json (kind, reproducibility record and capability labels), the scenario file (its hash, kind, seed and parameters), the field-units schema (each field's unit, provenance and evidence tier) and the verification matrix (each capability's VALIDATED, MODELLED or PARTNER label).” |
| Custom study | **Modelled PNT-resilience study (for example an optimism-gap audit)**. A bespoke, modelled positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) resilience study, reproducible from scenario, seed and engine version, every figure labelled; not a certification. | web/index.html:773 “PNT-resilience study — e.g. an optimism-gap audit — reproducible from scenario + seed + engine version” |
| Custom study | **Custom sensor and resilience models calibrated to your hardware**. Sensor and resilience models calibrated to the customer's own hardware, maintained in a private overlay. | README.md:671 “Custom sensor models — calibrated to your hardware, including export-sensitive resilience models maintained in a private overlay.” |
| Custom study | **Export-controlled resilience work under clearance and NDA**. Export-controlled resilience work delivered under the appropriate clearance and non-disclosure agreement (NDA). | web/index.html:766 “export-controlled resilience work delivered under the appropriate clearance and NDA” |
| Custom study | **Commercial support and integration**. Embedding Kshana in the customer's toolchain, custom scenarios and priority fixes. | README.md:669 “Commercial support & integration — embedding Kshana in your toolchain, custom scenarios, and priority fixes.” |
| Custom study | **Training and consulting**. Training and consulting on quantum and classical positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) performance analysis. | README.md:680 “Training & consulting on quantum/classical PNT performance analysis.” |
| Free core | **Commercial licence of the open core (dual licence, not Pro)**. The same open-core code under a commercial licence for closed or proprietary integration without Affero General Public License (AGPL) obligations. Listed beside Pro because buyers ask for it there, but the public source ties it to the open core. | web/index.html:751 “free under the AGPL-3.0 (or a commercial licence for closed/proprietary use)” |
